name: slimeshield-prevent-3-buff-slime
notes:
Slimeshield (hcpetipurz, ACTION/SPELL): "Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to target unit this turn. If that unit is a Slime ally, put a buff counter on it." Implemented as cardActivatedAbilities['hcpetipurz:0'] -> customDQHandlers['hcpetipurz:0:CardActivated-1'] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php): AddTurnEffect($target, 'PREVENT_ALL_3'), then an extra AddCounters(..., 'buff', 1) only if the target is an ALLY with the SLIME subtype. Unlike Baby Blue Slime's field-resident-REST-ability routing bug (documented above in this file), Slimeshield is a plain reserve-cost ACTION card and is correctly played through the normal hand-activation pipeline (DoActivateCard/ActivateCard) -- no routing concern here.

Its element is WIND, not native to the 'Spirit of Fire' starting champion, so the champion's Subcards are patched with a real WIND champion (Spirit of Wind, pNiyaGlIe7) purely to unlock element access. Red Slime (mttsvbgl6f, ALLY/SLIME) is seeded onto the field as the target, satisfying the 'also a Slime ally' buff-counter clause. Slimeshield is played for real from hand via FSM; a mid-resolution ambient opportunity (a hand-card response) is declined with PASS before the spell's own MZCHOOSE target prompt appears.

Verified live: myField-1 (Red Slime) ends with TurnEffects=['ENTERED_THIS_TURN','PREVENT_ALL_3'] and Counters={'buff':1}. Only the base effect is covered; the separate [Class Bonus][Level 2+] cost discount is not reached (default champion is level 0, no class bonus active).

rulesClauses: Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to target unit this turn. If that unit is a Slime ally, put a buff counter on it.
